reserveReview.rationale: The existing 2026-10-01 composition remains unchanged. Liquidity metadata was independently reviewed on 2026-10-03 at Ethereum block 26114893 (0xe34d12ddb9802b856a1e54db7968aa664b572660f10ad43c7878be4d327e746f): asset() is crvUSD, totalDebt()=0, totalIdle()=totalAssets(), and withdraw_limit_module() is the zero address. Exact-match Yearn V3 source returns the full owner's asset entitlement when idle assets suffice and no withdrawal module exists; Curve states deposited funds remain idle and always available for redemption. Immediate means local share-to-crvUSD availability, not guaranteed USD liquidation or parent collateral realization. Parent risks remain inherited; no maturity maximum is asserted.
